Product Details: Hillgrove HGCM1395M1 1200W 100% Copper Winding 26mm Rotary Hammer Impact Gun Chipping Hammering Drilling Breaker Drill Machine Kit Set with Angle Grinder - Distributed/Packaged by Hillgrove. Product Details: Take on the toughest drilling and demolition tasks with the Hillgrove 26mm Hammer Drill Machine, designed for both professional and heavy-duty home use. Equipped with a powerful 1200W motor, this SDS Plus hammer drill delivers exceptional performance across concrete, brick, wood, and metal. Its ergonomic design features a mode selector knob to switch easily between drill, hammer, and chisel functions, while the auxiliary handle, depth rod, and forward/reverse switch provide enhanced control and flexibility. With a 900 RPM max speed, a 26mm chuck size, and a 1.7m power cord, this tool ensures consistent, precise, and fatigue-free operation. The set includes multiple drill bits, chisel bits giving you everything you need for your next big project. The max drilling diameter for concrete is 26mm, wood is 30mm and for metal is 26mm. Key Features:- ✔Powerful 100% Copper Winding Motor: 1200W for high performance and durability. ✔3-in-1 Mode Selector: Switch between drill, hammer drill, and chiseling modes. ✔26mm Chuck Size: Supports heavy-duty bits for demanding tasks. ✔SDS Plus Compatible: Secure and quick bit changes. ✔Forward/Reverse Control: Perfect for drilling and unscrewing tasks. ✔Adjustable Depth Rod: Ensures drilling precision. ✔Max Speed: 0–900 RPM for optimal control. ✔Ergonomic Grip & 360 degree Auxilary Handle: Reduces fatigue and improves handling. ✔Double Layer Anti-Vibration System: For better and stable holding. ✔Heat Dissipation Design and Anti-Dust Bottom Structure: Increase machine's use life. ✔1.7m Power Cord: Allows free movement while working.
